Description: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), has authority, pursuant to Title 38 USC Chapter 36, to provide all services and assistance necessary to enable eligible Servicemembers, Veterans, and eligible Dependents to achieve their academic and vocational goals and objectives. The contractor will be required to provide assessment and counseling sessions to assist with the establishment of academic and vocational goals and objectives, the resolution of barriers interfering with goals and objectives, and the navigation and coordination of VA benefits in support of goals.
